title: Close all open Buddy work, implement fully, commit and push
summary: The lead answered the owner’s request with an inventory and then completed the authorized/selected work. Five initially open items were closed: mailing lists, inform preview/package verification, inactive-access UI (successor to the stale-grant task), and the lean Buddy repairs parent, plus follow-on verification. Other proposed backlog items were explicitly cancelled after owner delegated choices. The live Buddies package commit 49dfe08 remains local-only because ~/git/buddies had no remote; the app already vendors the fix. Feature branch work was pushed; current main contains the two cited app commits as ancestors. No active owned tasks from this thread appear dropped. A remote decision remains necessary only if package-owned history itself must be pushed.
nextAction: If the owner requires the package repository history to be pushed, have the Buddies Development Lead request an explicit destination remote from the owner; the app-side feature commits are already integrated in current main. Otherwise no follow-up is needed for this thread.
evidence: Thread replies post_15a1d1f7-a478-43bb-9630-fe690c7d02cc (provider failed), post_1822f3ac-2f1a-4591-b369-64c83a505301 (work inventory/status and delegated decisions), post_abe5afc3-6071-4023-aad1-5dbf43432a58 (owner asks lead to choose), post_6f93c984-f5b4-4977-9815-7ffeca1325d8 (decision/closure report), post_e8af1f54-027b-4835-b77a-f0f77a002d62 (final status and blocked package push).

Current task details: b53d3177 and 95592e35 done with commits 1e68159 and 4e4d878, boundary test, desktop/phone screenshots and HEAD/feature-branch checks; a2fa592f done with 87d58e9 and separate package test; ee12e5dd done with package and app evidence; 6efaffd1 done. Snapshot also records selected deferred work as cancelled.

Read-only git check: 4e4d878 and 87d58e9 are ancestors of current main HEAD f3d6cf1. Working tree has unrelated dirty/untracked changes, so no checks were run against it and no clean-tree claim is made. The September 24 task evidence says commits were pushed to feat/channels-project-view-2026-09-22; current local branch list lacks that feature branch, and remote state was not freshly fetched/verified.

Unresolved package-only publication: thread reports commit 49dfe08 on codex/channel-agent-tools-20260924 could not be pushed because ~/git/buddies has no remote and github.com/nbardy/buddies did not exist. The fix was vendored into the app as 87d58e9.
limitations: No tests or UI checks run for this audit; relied on dated task evidence and verified commit ancestry only.
The remote feature branch and package remote were not freshly queried; evidence about their state is from the dated thread/task records.
Current checkout is dirty with unrelated changes, so integrated means present in current main history, not that the checkout is a clean release artifact.
